verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built for agents: the CLI and hosted MCP use the same process service and company records [docs-19, docs-27]. The HTTP API documents process-guide reading and company-context operations [docs-20], and the CLI's `--json` mode gives agents structured output without interactive prompts [docs-7, docs-22]. However, the documented OpenAPI contract returns 404 on both hosts [audit-20261014-1, probe-2], no MCP session past the auth wall has been observed [audit-20261014-2], and nothing explicitly states that the API matches any UI feature for feature. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a reachable OpenAPI contract, hands-on verification of authenticated API/MCP operations covering the full feature set.
